description: This file declares the LifecycleManagerImplementation class, which implements multiple interfaces related to lifecycle management, state management, configuration, and event handling within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace. It includes class definitions, method declarations, and internal data members for managing application lifecycle events and notifications.

classes.name: LifecycleManagerImplementation
classes.description: Implements lifecycle, state, configuration, and event handling interfaces for managing application lifecycle within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for lifecycle events.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered notification callback.

methods.name: GetLoadedApps
methods.description: Retrieves a list of currently loaded applications.

methods.name: IsAppLoaded
methods.description: Checks if a specific application is loaded.

methods.name: SpawnApp
methods.description: Starts a new application instance with specified parameters.

methods.name: SetTargetAppState
methods.description: Changes the target state of an application.

methods.name: UnloadApp
methods.description: Unloads a running application.

methods.name: KillApp
methods.description: Terminates a running application.

methods.name: SendIntentToActiveApp
methods.description: Sends an intent to the active application.

methods.name: AppReady
methods.description: Marks an application as ready.

methods.name: StateChangeComplete
methods.description: Indicates completion of a state change for an application.

methods.name: CloseApp
methods.description: Closes an application with a specified reason.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the lifecycle manager with the provided service.

methods.name: onRuntimeManagerEvent
methods.description: Handles runtime manager events.

methods.name: onWindowManagerEvent
methods.description: Handles window manager events.

methods.name: onRippleEvent
methods.description: Handles ripple events.

methods.name: onStateChangeEvent
methods.description: Handles state change events.

methods.name: LifecycleManagerImplementation
methods.description: Constructor for the lifecycle manager implementation.

methods.name: ~LifecycleManagerImplementation
methods.description: Destructor for the lifecycle manager implementation.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the lifecycle manager with the given service.

methods.name: terminate
methods.description: Cleans up resources used by the lifecycle manager.

methods.name: dispatchEvent
methods.description: Dispatches an event based on the specified event name and parameters.

methods.name: Dispatch
methods.description: Internal method to dispatch events.

methods.name: handleRuntimeManagerEvent
methods.description: Processes runtime manager events.

methods.name: handleStateChangeEvent
methods.description: Processes state change events.

methods.name: handleWindowManagerEvent
methods.description: Processes window manager events.

methods.name: getContext
methods.description: Retrieves application context based on instance ID and app ID.

methods.name: addStateTransitionRequest
methods.description: Adds a request to transition an application's state.
